title: Towards a Holistic Approach: Understanding Sociodemographic Biases in NLP Models using an Interdisciplinary Lens

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating explicit bias using sentiment analysis and toxicity detection models via the Bias Identification Test in Sentiment (BITS) corpus, and measuring implicit bias by analyzing word embedding-based and transformer-based LLMs for ableist language.
Examining LLM-generated stories for various nationalities to establish a correlation between sentiment, the population of internet users, and the economic status of the country.
Applying sentiment analysis and toxicity detection models to identify explicit bias through the statistical exploration of conversations on social media platforms like Twitter and Reddit.
